answer: An identity binds itself to one home charger: each charging session is signed by the charger, recording start, end, and kilowatt-hours delivered to a specific vehicle. The island of one charger, one vehicle, one identity means a second account would need a second charger and car. The horizon of the session log is the utility meter, which sees the same energy, and the voyage of each kilowatt-hour from grid to battery is receipted, so a claim without a real EV behind it has no session to show.
